features.feature: Deliver one implementation-ready Markdown execution document for the six confirmed workflow convergence diagnoses, without changing runtime behavior or existing decision documents.
Map the six diagnoses into exactly five cohesive, independently executable workstreams rather than one cross-subsystem implementation story.
For each workstream record evidence-backed root cause, adopted/modified/rejected remedy, implementation boundary, dependencies, rollout/rollback, and positive plus negative acceptance criteria.
Preserve DONE evidence freshness while fixing timeout convergence: no max-only outer deadline and receipt reuse bound to HEAD, material, story-files, policy, and command set.
Preserve candidate-routing recall and configured shadow semantics while fixing unattended host liveness and generic-token over-scan.
Define fail-closed typed dispatch and stable per-task plus per-agent/role owner identity without allowing reviewer-to-implementer fallback or repository-wide identity collapse.
Canonicalize scope paths with explicit containment and replace ambiguous regex declaration anchors while preserving protected-anchor fail-closed behavior and explicit evidence staleness.
State canonical-source precedence, shared terminology, landing order, priority rationale, dependency graph, story slicing, risk controls, and explicit shortcut non-goals.
